copy.caption: Full day-by-day itinerary in the first comment. Ten days from Auckland: four nights in Beijing, three in Xi'an, and a high-speed train in between. Flights, hotels, an English-speaking tour guide, and the breakfasts and five lunches listed in the itinerary are in the price. NZD $3,480 per person, twin share; single supplement NZD $395. Travel insurance and tips are not included. Next departure 18 March 2027.
